Producer is scientist-b; this actor produced none of it. Predecessor passes: ALDAZ-VERIFY-W1-20260913 and ALDAZ-VERIFY-W2-20260913, both of which returned REFINED on every object they judged.
OBJECTIVE: Verify, from the sources and before any producer conclusion, scientist-b's two readings of the papers to which the corpus's tissue-distribution work delegates its antibody validation. Judge the propositions, the material omissions, the comparisons and the citations — and judge with particular care the two claims on which this lot's value rests: the measured validation standard, and the finding that the two series are one validation pipeline rather than two.

PRODUCER_SEPARATION.order_that_is_the_whole_control: Open each source artefact at its declared digest, form your own expected answer to each proposition, and only then compare. A verification that reads the producer's conclusion first is a review of a narrative.

WHAT_TO_JUDGE.1_propositions: Each locator triple against its source at the declared digest: does the quote support the proposition, and does the source say MORE or LESS than claimed. A figure-surface locator is an attestation, not a quote; judge whether the panel shows what it says, at the resolution the anchor names. 🔴 The producer records that five of its locators are eye-judgements on panels and that it obtained NO blind audit — it names this as residual risk. Those five are the first place to look.
WHAT_TO_JUDGE.2_the_validation_standard: The producer's headline is that the reagent reaches 'immunoblot-grade validation on epithelial lysates against a cell-line genetic null' and NOT immunohistochemistry-grade. Verify the positive half — the PEO1 null lanes, the add-back, whether actin runs in the same lane, whether a molecular-weight ladder exists in each paper — and the negative half: is there truly no no-primary, pre-immune, isotype, peptide-block, second-antibody or blot-to-IHC correspondence control in either paper? An absence claim is the hardest kind to verify and the easiest to get wrong in either direction.
WHAT_TO_JUDGE.3_one_pipeline_or_two: The producer concludes the two series are NOT two independent validations of the reagent — shared antibody concentration, shared cited null, shared ACIS platform and floor, shared immunostaining protocol by cross-citation, shared laboratory, 7 of 9 authors — while the DATA are largely independent (different tissue, cases, TMAs, blots). Judge both halves. Do not let the shared-pipeline finding bleed into a claim of shared data, and do not let independent data be reported as independent validation.
WHAT_TO_JUDGE.4_material_omissions: What do the sources carry that a reading at this declared depth should have carried, where its absence would change, narrow or qualify a conclusion.
WHAT_TO_JUDGE.5_comparisons_and_citations: Any value-and-comparator presented as one comparison needs a single source sentence attesting them together. And check cited CONTEXT, not citation existence — this lot's central finding is itself a citation-chain claim, so the chain's own links are in scope: does each paper actually delegate to its ref 12, and is that ref 12 PMID 14526170?
WHAT_TO_JUDGE.6_coverage_honesty: Do declared coverage values match what the artefacts show was opened? The producer declares supplementary as absent on the ground that the JATS declares zero supplementary material; judge that. A value honestly declared unavailable is correct behaviour, not a defect.
WHAT_TO_JUDGE.7_the_declared_corrections: This lot withdraws one of the producer's own earlier premises — `PREMISE: INFERENZA — the delegated control is adequate` in the PMID16941225 dossier — and names rather than edits it. Judge whether the withdrawal is justified and whether naming-not-editing was right.

THE_RULE_THAT_PROTECTS_THE_TRUTH: 🔴 A verifier finding can itself be wrong. Before recording a proposition as unsupported, re-open the named surface at the resolution the anchor gives and satisfy yourself that the source — not your expectation — is what you are reading. Never ask for a true statement to be deleted because a check disagrees with it. Where the artefact is genuinely ambiguous, the honest output is DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED with both readings stated. Twice in this batch a blind audit refused the side that requested it — once the verifier's proposed wording, once the producer's own draft — and both refusals were the right outcome.
DELIVERABLES: disease-models/wwox/research/verifications/2026-09-13_aldaz_w3_verification.md — a verdict per proposition (SUPPORTED / NARROWER_THAN_CLAIMED / UNSUPPORTED / NOT_JUDGEABLE, each naming the artefact and anchor), then the validation-standard assessment, the one-pipeline assessment, material omissions, comparison and citation findings, the coverage assessment, and a verdict per paper in Annex C.2 language
WAVE_3_RESULT in this task JSON, with DEFAULTS_TAKEN and STOP_LOG, required even when empty
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Every proposition in both packets has a verdict or is listed as not judged with the reason.
The validation-standard claim and the one-pipeline claim each carry an explicit verdict with the evidence you checked.
Expectations were formed before the producer's withheld files were opened, and the report says so.
No file the producer wrote is modified. You propose; the orchestrator and the producer act.
legend_lint.py . stays PASS, and the publication gate is read BEFORE each commit it authorises.

COMMITTING.how: bash scripts/legend_commit.sh "<message>" <path> [<path> ...] — never git commit directly; two Scientists are working in this checkout.

COMMITTING.never: No push. No modification of another actor's artefacts, no edit to the four scientific current files or disease_model.md, no regeneration of shared derived surfaces, no new tooling.

QUOTA_DISCIPLINE: 🔴 A predecessor of yours was killed by an API session limit with its deliverable written but uncommitted, and the orchestrator had to land it on its behalf. Commit each paper's verdicts as soon as they are fixed rather than holding both to the end. If you hit a rate limit, do not retry in a loop: stop, leave state durable, say so in one line. If the margin allows only one paper, do PMID 15982416 first — it carries the ovarian series, the null-control figure and the 'data not shown' IHC control claim.
STOP_POLICY_REMINDER: §21c governs. Stop only for a reserved act with no sanctioned alternative, or a condition with no safe default; otherwise take the safe default, record it in DEFAULTS_TAKEN, continue.

narrowings: 15982416 entries[20]: 'fields with no brown signal at all (F, H, I, K, L)' is exact for F, H and I; K carries sparse brown flecks and L a trace outside the epithelium. True of the tumour epithelium, not of the whole field. Changes nothing downstream; ranked last.

15692750 entries[17]: the qualifying sub-clause 'a faint second immunoreactive species in T98, and fainter still under T82' is NOT confirmable at the surface ceiling. The 1442x443 raster is the image embedded in the PDF, so it is the best obtainable surface and not a sampling choice; what is visible is sub-band density indistinguishable from halo or streaking. DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED on that clause with both readings recorded. Everything structural in the entry - 39/31 kD axis, band above 39 kD, per-gel NEG. lane blank for WWOX while carrying actin, composite declared in caption, no 46 kD mark - is confirmed in full, and the qualification it serves survives on the ovarian Fig 1B where discrete second species ARE unambiguous in five lanes.
WAVE_3_RESULT.unsupported: NONE. No proposition in either reading is unsupported by its source. The lot owes additions, not corrections.
WAVE_3_RESULT.validation_standard_verdict: CONFIRMED, with one refinement. Positive half verified: PEO1 null lane blank for WWOX in both papers; actin present in the same lane as the blank in both (stronger in the ovarian null lane, so it is demonstrably loaded); WWOX add-back present in 15982416 only; molecular-weight ladder present in 15692750 only (39 kD and 31 kD, band above 39 kD) and ABSENT from the whole of 15982416 Figure 1, with no 46 kD mark anywhere in the lot. REFINEMENT: neither paper carries both halves of the argument - the genetic add-back and the MW axis are in different papers - so the phrase is true of the pair and of neither paper singly. Negative half verified as an absence: no no-primary, pre-immune, isotype, peptide-block, second-antibody-only or normal-rabbit-IgG control in either paper, and no blot-to-IHC correspondence control, which is structural because both blot series are specimen sets separate from their TMA cases. The 'data not shown' pre-absorption exists in 15982416 as text only and NO panel anywhere carries it - checked across 4 figures/17 panels, all 5 deposited ESM objects (which are exactly Figure 1A alone plus Figures 1-4), the springer_figs set, and 0 JATS supplementary-material elements with no Additional file listing in the BMC HTML. Sharper form the lot supports: 15692750, the paper the ovarian series cites for the antibody AND the immunostaining protocol AND the ACIS scoring, contains no IHC specificity control of any kind and the word 'specificity' does not occur in it.
WAVE_3_RESULT.one_pipeline_verdict: CONFIRMED on both halves, and the shared half is BROADER than claimed. All six of the producer's shared items verified. Three further shared items found by whitespace-normalised comparison of the two fingerprinted surfaces: (1) the immunoblot Methods are effectively verbatim identical, RIPA recipe character-for-character, same supplier, 50 ug protein, 12.5% SDS-PAGE, PVDF/Millipore, Protein Detector/KPL, anti-rabbit HRP 1:2000, anti-actin ICN 1:1000, anti-mouse HRP 1:5000, same Kodak Image Station 440CF - the only difference across all of it is the glyph ug versus the micro sign; (2) the ACIS scoring paragraph is shared verbatim including the TMA-core sentence, the brown-intensity sentence, the 63-of-255 floor and the SPSS version string; (3) the same grant funds both (NIH-NCI RO1 CA102444), the ovarian author-contribution statement says a shared author prepared the antibody, and its acknowledgements thank a person who is an author of the breast paper. Author overlap re-counted from the two lists: breast 9, ovarian 11, intersection 7 - '7 of 9' is exact. DATA half independent and correctly kept apart: different tissue, different case sets (444 vs 234; 38 vs 23 blot samples), different microarrays from different institutions, different blots with different normal comparators. NO BLEED FOUND IN EITHER DIRECTION: the producer does not let shared pipeline imply shared data, nor independent data imply independent validation.
WAVE_3_RESULT.eye_judgement_locators: Residual risk DISCHARGED. The producer named five panel eye-judgements (15982416 entries 16, 17, 19, 20, 21) and no blind audit. All five independently re-inspected from the same artefacts at equal or higher magnification (native, 3x, 4x, 7x): four confirmed in full, one narrowed on a non-load-bearing absolute. Entry 17 is the best finding in the lot - both blot seams are exactly where the producer puts them, located by background-density steps and a break in the actin strip itself. ONE CORRECTION TO THE RISK STATEMENT: the count of five covers the ovarian paper only; the breast reading adds four more panel attestations (entries 17-20), so the lot contains NINE, not five. All nine were checked; the second narrowing sits among the four uncounted ones.
material_omissions_ranked: 1. The ovarian ABSTRACT claims two significant histotypes ('Mucinous (70%) and Clear Cell (42%)') while Table 1's only statistic is the mucinous footnote (chi2=8.67; p=0.0131), the Discussion downgrades clear cell to 'Borderline significance', and NO p value for clear cell exists anywhere in the paper. The abstract is the surface that gets cited.

2. The ovarian blot's '38 tumors' are 38 LANES over at most 37 distinct tumours: Figure 1B labels both T123-1 and T123-2, read at 4x and 7x and unambiguous, while every proportion (10/38, 13/38, 15/38) uses 38. Whether they are one tumour twice or two lesions is stated nowhere and T123 is never mentioned in the text.

3. The ovarian paper's PUBLISHED text prints '=' where '<=' is meant, in the sentences defining its whole staining dichotomy ('cores with values = 63', 'Values between 63 and = 65'). NOT an extraction defect: the rendered page shows the printed glyph, and the JATS, BMC HTML and publisher PDF text layer all agree, while the companion breast paper prints the correct <= twice. Unrecorded in manifest and receipt; a future locator anchored there would quote a defective published string while passing every check, the suspicion-by-absence screen included. Related and smaller: '85% (70/82) ... 15% (12/83)' cannot both hold, since 70+12=82 and Table 2 confirms 70 and 12.

4. The ovarian Results report tests the Methods never declare: '-b = -0.135; p trend = 0.007' (a coefficient plus a trend test, almost certainly the Kendall's tau-b the companion paper DOES declare) and a survival p = 0.03 with no test named. Two of three headline associations rest on undeclared methods.

5. The ovarian paper carries two non-identical immunogen descriptions - 'raised against the WW domains [2]' against 'the recombinant GST-WWOX fusion protein used to raise the antibody'. Recorded in the producer's multihop block but not in a proposition, and the immunogen is the premise of entry 0's isoform-detection expectation.
6. The breast series is 234 cases in Methods (16+203+15) and '235 samples' in Results; the case-level nuclear-staining negative is stated over a total the paper contradicts by one.
7. The breast paper's four aggressiveness nulls (lymph node, metastasis, staging, nuclear grade) carry no displayed statistic anywhere - Table 2 has no rows for them.
immaterial: ovarian Table 2 prints relapse p = 0.09 where the Results text gives p = 0.094.
WAVE_3_RESULT.comparisons_and_citations: No value-and-comparator pair is presented as one comparison without a single attesting sentence. Citation CONTEXT traced from the artefacts, not existence: 15982416 ref 12 = 15692750 (three separate delegations - antibody, immunostaining protocol, ACIS scoring); 15692750 ref 12 = 14526170, read off the deposit's own [PubMed: 14526170] marker; the PEO1 null imported by BOTH from the same source (ovarian ref 4, breast ref 8 = 11572989); the compartment disagreement is 14695174 in both (ovarian ref 27, breast ref 16), answered two different ways. Chain: 15982416 -> 15692750 -> 14526170, terminus unread in this corpus. CORRECTION AGAINST MY OWN DISPATCH, not the producer: the task contract instructs that 'each paper delegates to its own ref 12 and ref 12 is PMID 14526170'. That holds for 15692750 ONLY; for 15982416 ref 12 is 15692750 and the 14526170 citation is its ref 2, the immunogen sentence. The producer's packet states the chain correctly and precisely; the compression is in the dispatch, and a later reader working from the contract alone would look for the wrong reference number and conclude the chain was broken.
WAVE_3_RESULT.coverage_assessment: Both receipts honest; no section declared read has an absent surface and no coverage value overstates what was opened. supplementary not_present is correct for both, and for 15982416 correct for a better reason than stated - the MOESM objects are not supplementary data but the article's own Figures 1-4 as BMC deposits them, already covered under figures: read, so declaring them present would have been the error. limitations not_present correct for both. references read correct and honestly bounded in both (38 refs re-counted, 12 declared enumerated-not-resolved; 21 refs with identifiers read off the deposit rather than searched). figures read earned: 17/17 and 12/12 panels exist and were inspected, and I re-opened all of them. Surface choice right and verifiable: the ovarian figures were judged on the deposited ESM rasters in preference to the 1525-px PDF extracts and 1200-px springer_figs, i.e. the best available in every case; for the breast paper efetch refused, the refusal is named in the artefact tree, and the PDF text layer screens clean (carries <=, minus, micro, degree, chi). Both dependency screens declare the unscreenable fraction rather than hiding it. CREDIT: the ovarian manifest records declared_before_reading: false against itself, and the breast manifest frames its own true as a correction of the first.
WAVE_3_RESULT.declared_correction_verdict: WITHDRAWAL JUSTIFIED, AND NAMING-NOT-EDITING WAS RIGHT. 'PREMISE: INFERENZA - the delegated control is adequate' stands at line 103 of the PMID16941225 dossier, resting on then-unread 15692750 and 15982416, with line 293 recording both as load-bearing. That premise carries its own REVIVAL_TRIGGER: 'a complete read of those two papers showing an IHC-level control, or any pre-absorption/no-primary panel'. The trigger is NOT met - there is no IHC-level control in either paper and no pre-absorption or no-primary panel in any surface of either - so the withdrawal is justified on the earlier reading's own declared terms, which is the strongest form available because the condition was written before the answer was known. Naming was right substantively (the premise was honestly recorded and correctly tagged INFERENZA; it did not become false, it became answered, and 'nothing dies in silence' applies to premises as much as to rejections) and procedurally (editing another actor's persisted dossier is outside a reading's perimeter exactly as it is outside mine).
WAVE_3_RESULT.evidence_needed_next: A complete read of PMID 14526170 - the terminus of the specificity chain and, on this pass's evidence, the highest-value unread paper the lot identifies. Then 11572989 for the PEO1-null premise both papers import, and 15073846 (Guler 2004) for whether the only named external corroboration used an independent antibody, which is exactly what the independence question needs and what neither paper says.

second_pass_result.audit_the_producer_declined: The diagnosis's blind_auditor: 0 line names five panel eye-judgements and no blind audit, and calls it 'the strongest argument in this diagnosis for a review I did not obtain'. My section 9 correction is fair as stated: the five are the ovarian paper's, and the lot carries nine across both papers; I checked all nine.
